title: Catalpol rescues LPS-induced cognitive impairment via inhibition of NF-Kappab-regulated neuroinflammation and up-regulation of TrkB-mediated BDNF secretion in mice.
authors: Hu, Weiqing; Zou, Li; Yu, Ningxi; Wu, Zhizhongbin; Yang, Wei; Wu, Tianyue; Liu, Yulin; Pu, Yu; Jiang, Yunbing; Zhang, Jifeng; Zhu, Huifeng; Cheng, Fang; Feng, Shan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药梓醇改善脓毒症相关脑病的神经保护机制，涉及NF-κB和TrkB通路，但核心是神经炎症与认知行为，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Septic-associated encephalopathy (SAE) is a key manifestation of sepsis. Nevertheless, specific treatment for SAE is still lacking. Catalpol is an active component derived from Rehmanniae Radix, and has been demonstrated to be a potential neuroprotective agent. However, its effect on SAE still needs to be fully explored. AIM: To address the benefits of catalpol on post-sepsis cognitive deterioration and related mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Novel object recognition test, temporal order task, histopathology, and immunochemistry were applied to address the benefits of catalpol on LPS-triggered post-sepsis cognitive decline in mice. Xuebijing injection (10 ml/kg) has been utilized as a positive control in the above animal studies. After treatment, the catalpol content in the hippocampus was determined using LC-MS/MS. Finally, the mechanisms of catalpol were further assessed in BV2 and PC12 cells in vitro using Western blot, RT-PCR, flow cytometry, molecular docking tests, thermal shift assay, transmission electron microscopy, and immunofluorescence analysis. RESULTS: Behavior tests showed that catalpol therapy could lessen the cognitive impairment induced by LPS damage. HE, Nissl, immunofluorescence, transmission electron microscopy, and Golgi staining further reflected that catalpol treatment could restore lymphocyte infiltration, blood-brain barrier (BBB) degradation, and the decreasing complexity of dendritic trees. According to LC-MS/MS analysis, catalpol had a 136 ng/mg concentration in the hippocampus. In vitro investigation showed that catalpol could inhibit microglia M1 polarization via blocking NF-kappaB phosphorylation, translocation and then reducing inflammatory cytokine release in BV2 microglia cells. Brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) release up-regulation and TrkB pathway activation were observed in the catalpol treatment group in vivo and in vitro. The effect of catalpol on enhancing BDNF expression was inhibited by the specific inhibitor of TrkB (GNF-5837) in PC12 cells. Further molecular docking tests showed that catalpol formed weak hydrophobic bonds with TrkB. Besides, thermal shift assay also reflected that catalpol incubation caused a considerable change in the melting temperature of the TrkB. CONCLUSION: Catalpol alleviates LPS-triggered post-sepsis cognitive impairment by reversing neuroinflammation via blocking the NF-kappaB pathway, up-regulating neurotrophic factors via the activation of TrkB pathway, and preserving BBB integrity.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：脓毒症相关脑病（SAE）是脓毒症的关键表现。然而，针对SAE的特异性治疗仍然缺乏。梓醇（Catalpol）是源自地黄（Rehmanniae Radix）的一种活性成分，已被证明是一种潜在的神经保护剂。然而，其对SAE的作用仍需充分探索。目的：探讨梓醇对脓毒症后认知功能衰退的益处及其相关机制。材料与方法：采用新物体识别测试、时间顺序任务、组织病理学和免疫化学方法，评估梓醇对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的小鼠脓毒症后认知功能衰退的益处。在上述动物研究中，血必净注射液（10 ml/kg）作为阳性对照。治疗后，使用液相色谱-串联质谱法（LC-MS/MS）测定海马中梓醇的含量。最后，在体外使用Western blot、RT-PCR、流式细胞术、分子对接测试、热位移分析、透射电子显微镜和免疫荧光分析进一步评估梓醇的机制。结果：行为测试显示，梓醇治疗可减轻LPS损伤诱导的认知障碍。HE、尼氏染色、免疫荧光、透射电子显微镜和高尔基染色进一步反映，梓醇治疗可恢复淋巴细胞浸润、血脑屏障（BBB）降解和树突树复杂性降低。根据LC-MS/MS分析，梓醇在海马中的浓度为136 ng/mg。体外研究表明，梓醇可通过阻断NF-kappaB磷酸化、转位，进而减少BV2小胶质细胞中炎症细胞因子的释放，抑制小胶质细胞M1极化。在体内和体外梓醇治疗组中观察到脑源性神经营养因子（BDNF）释放上调和TrkB通路激活。在PC12细胞中，梓醇增强BDNF表达的作用被TrkB特异性抑制剂（GNF-5837）抑制。进一步的分子对接测试显示，梓醇与TrkB形成弱疏水键。此外，热位移分析也反映，梓醇孵育导致TrkB熔解温度发生显著变化。结论：梓醇通过阻断NF-kappaB通路逆转神经炎症、通过激活TrkB通路上调神经营养因子，并维持BBB完整性，从而减轻LPS诱导的脓毒症后认知障碍。
